name: Tidewater Coffee Roasters
tagline: Small-batch coffee, roasted on the coast.
heroBody: We roast in small batches by the harbour and ship within two days of roasting. Beans, and the few tools we would use to brew them.
heroAlt: Roasted coffee beans in a burlap sack

perks.title: Roasted to order
perks.body: Shipped within two days of roasting.

perks.title: Brew help included
perks.body: Every bag comes with a recipe card.

shipping: Ships within two days of roasting · Free shipping over $40

closing.title: New to brewing at home?
closing.body: Start with the Harbor House Blend and the French press. It is the most forgiving way to make a good cup, and it needs no paper filters.

products.name: Harbor House Blend Whole Bean Coffee, 340 g
products.blurb: Chocolate, toasted almond, a clean finish.
products.description: Our everyday whole bean coffee: a medium roast of Colombian and Brazilian beans with notes of chocolate and toasted almond. 340 g bag.

products.name: Ethiopia Guji Single Origin Coffee, 340 g
products.blurb: Light roast with blueberry and jasmine.
products.description: A light-roast single origin whole bean coffee from Guji, Ethiopia, with notes of blueberry and jasmine. 340 g kraft bag.

products.name: Glass Pour-Over Coffee Brewer, 6 Cup
products.blurb: Hourglass brewer with a wooden collar.
products.description: A six-cup glass pour-over coffee brewer with a wooden collar and leather tie. Uses bonded paper filters for a clean cup.

products.name: Glass French Press, 1 Litre
products.description: A one-litre glass French press with a stainless steel plunger and fine mesh filter. Makes four mugs of full-bodied coffee.

products.name: Speckled Stoneware Coffee Cup, 300 ml
products.blurb: Hand-thrown, no handle, warm in the hand.
products.description: A hand-thrown speckled stoneware coffee cup without a handle. Holds 300 ml. Each one is slightly different.
